fields.title: Industrial Tapes & Packaging | Tape Solutions
fields.description: Explore professional aluminium and construction tapes, films and packaging materials at Tape Solutions. Browse products or request a quotation.

products.name: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather
products.description: Suitable for sealing insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts. Features strong adhesion, a cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available pack sizes: 50 mm × 45 m (24 rolls), 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (16 rolls).
products.short_description: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with cold-weather acrylic adhesive for insulation and sealing.

products.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO
products.description: Designed for demanding marine insulation and sealing applications. Flame-retardant aluminium tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive; TPS Pack states temperature resistance from −40°C to +140°C. Available in 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (12 rolls).
products.short_description: IMO/MED-certified premium aluminium tape with strong cold-weather adhesion.

products.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
products.description: Glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tape described by TPS Pack as IMO/MED-certified for marine use. Available in 50 mm × 50 m, 75 mm × 50 m and 100 mm × 50 m formats. Confirm current pack quantities before ordering.
products.short_description: Marine-grade, glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tracing tape with strong adhesion.

products.name: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape
products.description: Heavy-adhesive butyl tape for sealing seams, closures, frames, roofs and façades. Designed for waterproof repair and sealing applications. Available in 50 mm × 15 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 15 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 15 m (12 rolls).
products.short_description: Water-resistant and vapour-tight butyl repair tape for sealing joints and connections.

products.name: PP-Coated Aluminium Tape
products.description: Premium polypropylene-aluminium tape with an aluminium coating, suitable for use in both cool and warm conditions. Intended for joining laminate foils and sealing insulation materials. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 100 m rolls in webshop pack formats; TPS Pack also lists 50 m lengths elsewhere.
products.short_description: PP-aluminium tape for joining laminate foil and sealing insulation materials.

products.name: Black Aluminium Tape AW
products.description: Strong-adhesion black aluminium tape for sealing and finishing insulation materials. TPS Pack lists cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 50 m rolls.
products.short_description: Black cold-weather aluminium tape for a neat finish on dark insulation.

products.name: Length-Reinforced Filament Tape
products.description: Length-reinforced filament tape designed for strong packaging and bundling applications. The glass fibres increase tear resistance. Available in widths of 19, 25, 38, 50, 75 and 100 mm, each on 50 m rolls, with pack quantities listed per option.
products.short_description: Glass-fibre-reinforced filament tape for securing and sealing heavy packaging.

products.name: Double-Sided Adhesive Tape
products.description: Strong tape for permanent attachment of materials such as carpets and carpet tiles.
products.short_description: Strong tape for permanent attachment of materials such as carpets and carpet tiles.

products.name: Waterproof Duct Tape
products.description: Water-resistant duct tape with strong adhesion; available in different colours, sizes and thicknesses.
products.short_description: Water-resistant duct tape with strong adhesion; available in different colours, sizes and thicknesses.

products.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm
products.description: Machine-grade clear pallet wrapping film. Roll dimensions: 500 mm width × 2000 m length; thickness 17 µm and a stated stretch level of 250%. Packaging and order quantities vary.
products.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 17 µm thick, with 250% stretch.

products.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm
products.description: Machine stretch wrap for securing palletised goods. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1800 m; film thickness 20 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.
products.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 20 µm thick, with 300% stretch.

products.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm
products.description: Machine wrapping film intended to stabilise pallet loads. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1500 m; thickness 23 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.
products.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 23 µm thick, with 300% stretch.

products.name: Cardboard Edge Protectors – Pack of 50
products.description: Pack of 50 cardboard edge protectors used to protect exposed corners and reinforce palletised loads. TPS Pack also offers corner profiles in a range of widths, lengths and thicknesses; confirm the exact dimensions of this pack before ordering.
products.short_description: Cardboard corner protectors for pallet and package edge protection.

products.name: Double-Sided Foam Tape
products.description: White foam tape with pressure-sensitive adhesive on both sides. TPS Pack states operating temperature suitability from −30°C to +80°C, strong adhesion and good water resistance. Available in multiple thicknesses.
products.short_description: Strong, water-resistant double-sided foam tape for mounting and sealing.

products.name: Blue Marine Masking Tape – 14-Day UV
products.description: Blue crepe-paper masking tape with resistance to water and solvents, intended for modern paint systems. TPS Pack specifies UV resistance for up to 14 days and temperature resistance up to 110°C.
products.short_description: Flexible blue masking tape with 14-day UV resistance.

products.name: ISOHULK Aluminium FSK Tape IMO
products.description: Premium fibre-reinforced aluminium FSK tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive. TPS Pack specifies IMO/MED certification and operating temperature resistance from −40°C to +120°C. Available in several dimensions and thicknesses.
products.short_description: IMO/MED-certified aluminium FSK tape for cold-weather insulation applications.

products.name: High-Temperature Aluminium Tape – 300°C
products.description: Designed to seal insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts in high-temperature settings. TPS Pack lists heat resistance up to 300°C and DIN 4102 A1 classification. Different widths and thicknesses are available.
products.short_description: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with heat-resistant adhesive rated up to 300°C.

products.name: Reinforced Aluminium Tape
products.description: Aluminium sealing tape for insulation blankets and ductwork. Lengthwise and crosswise reinforcement improves tear resistance, while the cold-weather acrylic adhesive supports application at lower temperatures.
products.short_description: Tear-resistant aluminium tape reinforced lengthwise and crosswise.

products.name: Glass Cloth Marine Tape GM3
products.description: Glass cloth tape used to seal glass-fibre insulation in marine environments. TPS Pack describes IMO certification and good performance at elevated temperatures.
products.short_description: IMO-certified glass cloth tape for marine insulation work.

products.name: Washi Masking Tape – Gold + Foil
products.description: Gold + Foil washi masking tape from the TPS Pack construction tape range.
products.short_description: Gold + Foil washi masking tape from the TPS Pack construction tape range.

products.name: Elastomeric Arma Foam Insulation Tape
products.description: Self-adhesive elastomeric foam tape for use with Armaflex-type pipe and duct insulation. Designed to help reduce condensation. Specified size: 3 mm thickness × 50 mm width × 15 m length.
products.short_description: Self-adhesive foam insulation tape for finishing insulated pipes and ducts.

products.name: Washi Masking Tape – Gold, 3-Month UV
products.description: Gold washi masking tape listed with three-month UV resistance.
products.short_description: Gold washi masking tape listed with three-month UV resistance.

products.name: PLUS Hand Stretch Film – 500 mm × 300 m × 20 µm
products.description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 20 µm, for stabilising pallet loads.
products.short_description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 20 µm, for stabilising pallet loads.

products.description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 23 µm, for securing pallet loads.
products.short_description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 23 µm, for securing pallet loads.

products.short_description: PET strapping for securing loads and packaging; confirm dimensions and strength.

products.name: Washi Masking Tape – Lilac Low Tack
products.description: Low-tack lilac washi masking tape for delicate surfaces.
products.short_description: Low-tack lilac washi masking tape for delicate surfaces.

products.name: Glossy Non-Adhesive PVC Pipe Wrapping Tape
products.description: Glossy PVC pipe-wrapping tape without an adhesive layer.
products.short_description: Glossy PVC pipe-wrapping tape without an adhesive layer.

products.name: Pure Aluminium Foil
products.description: 100% pure aluminium foil supplied in jumbo rolls in different sizes and thicknesses.
products.short_description: 100% pure aluminium foil supplied in jumbo rolls in different sizes and thicknesses.

products.name: Scrim-Reinforced Aluminium Foil
products.description: Jumbo-roll aluminium foil reinforced with glass-fibre scrim, available in different dimensions and thicknesses.
products.short_description: Jumbo-roll aluminium foil reinforced with glass-fibre scrim, available in different dimensions and thicknesses.

products.name: Diamond-Reinforced Aluminium Foil
products.description: Jumbo-roll aluminium foil reinforced with diamond-pattern glass fibres.
products.short_description: Jumbo-roll aluminium foil reinforced with diamond-pattern glass fibres.

products.name: Fibreglass Cloth Foil – 430/m²
products.description: Fibreglass cloth foil supplied on jumbo rolls in different sizes and thicknesses; verify the 430/m² unit before ordering.
products.short_description: Fibreglass cloth foil supplied on jumbo rolls in different sizes and thicknesses; verify the 430/m² unit before ordering.

products.name: Premium Weatherproof Thermal Jacketing Film
products.description: Weatherproof cladding film for finishing insulation projects, available in different types, colours and sizes.
products.short_description: Weatherproof cladding film for finishing insulation projects, available in different types, colours and sizes.

products.name: PLUS Hand Stretch Film – 500 mm × 300 m × 17 µm
products.description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 17 µm, for securing pallets.
products.short_description: Transparent hand stretch wrap, 500 mm × 300 m × 17 µm, for securing pallets.

products.name: Machine Stretch Film – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm (350%)
products.description: Transparent machine stretch film, 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm, with 350% stretch.
products.short_description: Transparent machine stretch film, 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm, with 350% stretch.

products.name: Three-Layer Bubble Wrap – 100 µm
products.description: Three-layer, 100 µm bubble wrap for cushioning and protecting goods; various sizes available.
products.short_description: Three-layer, 100 µm bubble wrap for cushioning and protecting goods; various sizes available.

products.name: Pallet Top Sheets
products.description: Protective pallet top sheets supplied on rolls, available in clear or black and in various sizes and thicknesses.
products.short_description: Protective pallet top sheets supplied on rolls, available in clear or black and in various sizes and thicknesses.

products.name: PP Strapping Band
products.description: Polypropylene strapping for bundling and securing packages. Check the required width and strength.
products.short_description: Polypropylene strapping for bundling and securing packages. Check the required width and strength.

products.name: Paper Strapping Band
products.description: Paper strapping material for bundling packages; dimensions to be confirmed.
products.short_description: Paper strapping material for bundling packages; dimensions to be confirmed.

products.name: Polyester Strapping Band
products.description: Polyester strapping for packaging and bundling; confirm dimensions and tensile strength.
products.short_description: Polyester strapping for packaging and bundling; confirm dimensions and tensile strength.

products.name: Spray Adhesive – 500 ml
products.description: Fast-acting 500 ml spray adhesive with high initial tack and quick permanent bonding.
products.short_description: Fast-acting 500 ml spray adhesive with high initial tack and quick permanent bonding.
